stories.title: Bitfinex 以太坊巨鯨長倉創四年高，現貨 ETF 卻持續流出
stories.title_en: Ethereum Whales Build Record Longs on Bitfinex Amid Price Pressure
stories.summary: Traders on Bitfinex now hold about 390,000 ETH in longs, up more than fourfold since September, echoing setups before past rallies like the…
stories.summary_en: Traders on Bitfinex now hold about 390,000 ETH in longs, up more than fourfold since September, echoing setups before past rallies like the 100% surge from June 2022. This buildup contrasts with heavy outflows from spot Ethereum ETFs, including $155 million on October 30, while ETH hovers around $2,242 with oversold signals on the daily RSI near 30. Observers see the whale activity as a strong conviction bet, though a weekly close below the Bull Market Support Band could spell trouble for buyers.
stories.why_it_matters: 衍生品多頭同 ETF 流出背離，影響 ETH 方向同模擬倉風險偏好。

stories.title: Binance 錄得史上最大約 $63 億熱錢包被盜（疑朝鮮駭客）
stories.title_en: Binance Hit by Record $6.3 Billion Crypto Heist from Hot Wallets
stories.summary: 10/29 跨鏈熱錢包遭疑似朝鮮 TraderTraitor 襲擊；Binance 承諾用儲備／SAFU 全額賠付，已聯同夥伴凍結約 $30 億，服務約 34 小時內恢復。
stories.summary_en: Blockchain analysts called it the largest crypto theft ever, linked to North Korean group TraderTraitor via a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop and no leaked private keys. Binance stepped up immediately, promising to cover all losses from its SAFU fund and treasury, freezing $3 billion on-chain with partners like Tether and Circle. Bitcoin dropped below $77,000 with over $1 billion in liquidations, yet some traders viewed it as a temporary shakeout and held bullish positions around the $76,000 level. The exchange paused withdrawals for reviews but assured customer funds stayed safe and separate.
stories.why_it_matters: 史上最大所內盜案牽動清算同監管敘事，短線波動仍高。

stories.title: Cursor 市集惡意 Claude Code 擴充感染約 5000 開發者
stories.title_en: Malicious Claude Code Extension Hits Cursor Marketplace, Exposing 5,000 Developers
stories.summary: The fake version 2.1.313 appeared in Cursor's marketplace for about 11 hours, from 2:27 a.m. to 1:35 p.m. Pacific time. It grabbed host…
stories.summary_en: The fake version 2.1.313 appeared in Cursor's marketplace for about 11 hours, from 2:27 a.m. to 1:35 p.m. Pacific time. It grabbed host details like usernames and IP addresses, attempted to add an attacker-controlled SSH key named “svc-telemetry,” and set up a reverse tunnel to a suspicious server. Cursor quickly pulled the package, audited extensions, shut down the marketplace briefly, and released a clean version 2.1.314, while Anthropic confirmed their systems stayed secure. Developers face cleanup steps to remove lingering artifacts, as flaws limited the malware's reach but supply-chain risks remain a stark reminder for the community.
stories.why_it_matters: 開發者供應鏈攻擊升溫，同加密熱錢包／腳本安全同一風險面。

stories.title: 多個 DeFi 站點遭 DNS 劫持植入 Step Drainer
stories.title_en: DeFi Sites Hit by DNS Hijacking Attacks on Halloween
stories.summary: Blockaid 警示 flap.sh、kintsu.xyz、stonkfun.xyz、pickle.finance 等遭前端／DNS 劫持，籲勿連錢包並核對官方域名。
stories.summary_en: Security firm Blockaid warned of frontend attacks on sites including flap.sh, kintsu.xyz, stonkfun.xyz, and others like pickle.finance and fluxbeam.xyz, where hackers used DNS hijacking to serve malicious Step Drainer toolkits. Affected projects like Flap confirmed the issue, took sites offline or migrated to new domains such as flap.cool, and urged users not to connect wallets or sign transactions. No on-chain funds were lost, but teams advised revoking approvals via tools like revoke.cash for anyone who interacted with the tampered sites after midnight UTC.
stories.why_it_matters: 連線釣魚風險升溫；真錢包操作要格外小心。

stories.title: Zeru Finance 上線委託熱錢包讀冷錢包歷史
stories.title_en: Zeru Finance Launches Delegate Wallet for Secure Zaps Access
stories.summary: Zeru Finance introduced Delegate Wallet Connection on its Zaps platform, using Delegate.xyz to link a hot wallet to cold wallet vaults…
stories.summary_en: Zeru Finance introduced Delegate Wallet Connection on its Zaps platform, using Delegate.xyz to link a hot wallet to cold wallet vaults while keeping the cold storage offline. This solves a key frustration by letting users maintain security habits, with all vault activity still counting toward scoring and rewards like zScore. Traders appreciate how it tracks full history without setup changes, and users can link up to 10 wallets per account via ownership signatures. Community members view it as a smart step that values real onchain contributions alongside strong security.
stories.why_it_matters: 冷熱分離計分工具普及，ActivityFi 賽道繼續加溫。

stories.title: Binance 承諾以自有儲備全數填補約 $63 億被盜損失
stories.title_en: Binance Covers $6.3 Billion Hack Losses from North Korean Attack
stories.summary: Analysts from TRM Labs, Chainalysis, and Elliptic tied the attack to North Korean groups, who exploited an Ethereum delegation to bypass…
stories.summary_en: Analysts from TRM Labs, Chainalysis, and Elliptic tied the attack to North Korean groups, who exploited an Ethereum delegation to bypass controls. Binance co-CEO Richard Teng confirmed customer funds in cold storage stayed safe, with the platform pausing withdrawals for checks and planning a Proof of Reserves snapshot soon. Stablecoin issuers froze $3 billion in assets, while Bitcoin dipped below $77,000 amid $1.5 billion in market liquidations, testing support at $76,000. Community members expressed relief at the full reimbursement promise, though some eyed upcoming phased restorations for signs of stability.
stories.why_it_matters: 交易所兌付承諾同凍結進度，直接影響週末流動性同 BTC 情緒。

stories.title: Chainalysis 自身遭入侵，非敏感客戶資料外洩
stories.title_en: Chainalysis Discloses Security Breach of Customer Data
stories.summary: 外來者存取非敏感客戶資料（名、電郵、用戶 ID、角色）；公司稱調查數據、密碼同錢包金鑰未受影響。
stories.summary_en: An external actor accessed non-sensitive customer details like names, emails, user IDs, and roles, but no investigation data, passwords, or tokens were compromised. The company detected the incident this month, patched vulnerabilities with expert help, and stressed it's unrelated to recent Binance thefts. Customers now face phishing risks, so Chainalysis urges enabling two-factor authentication and staying vigilant for updates.
stories.why_it_matters: 鏈上執法基礎設施受襲，或增釣魚同詐騙跟進風險。

stories.title: 東京上市 Iole 虧本清倉 BTC，轉投 AI 數據中心（保留 HYPE）
stories.title_en: Tokyo Firm Sells All Bitcoin for AI Data Centers
stories.summary: Iole plans to sell 151.21 BTC by late November through crypto exchanges, booking a ¥254 million ($1.6 million) loss after re-evaluating…
stories.summary_en: Iole plans to sell 151.21 BTC by late November through crypto exchanges, booking a ¥254 million ($1.6 million) loss after re-evaluating amid cyber threats. The proceeds will fund AI data centers, computing power, and its Neo Cloud business, with an extra ¥600 million shifted from other plans. While reactions call it everything from pragmatic to 'degen,' the firm holds onto its Hyperliquid (HYPE) holdings acquired earlier this year.
stories.why_it_matters: 企業庫存 BTC 轉 AI 基建，強化風險偏好分流；HYPE 倉保留對山寨敘事有參考。

stories.title: 比特幣白皮書 18 週年：從危機提案到約 $1.55 萬億網絡
stories.title_en: Bitcoin Whitepaper Turns 18: From Crisis-Era Proposal to $1.55 Trillion Network
stories.summary: 2008-10-31 Satoshi 向密碼學郵件列表發出 Bitcoin whitepaper；18 年後網絡市值約 $1.55 萬億，週末紀念帖同歷史敘事升溫。
stories.summary_en: On October 31, 2008, Satoshi emailed a cryptography list with the Bitcoin whitepaper, outlining a system using digital signatures, proof-of-work, and a peer-to-peer network to enable direct online payments and prevent double-spending. The network launched in January 2009, with Satoshi mining the genesis block and later stepping away, leaving a decentralized system that now boasts a $1.55 trillion market cap and prices near $77,000. Community reflections celebrate its resilience through halvings, hacks, and scrutiny, evolving from electronic cash into a global store of value backed by institutions and even governments.
stories.why_it_matters: 白皮書週年強化 BTC 長期敘事同週末情緒；對模擬倉風險偏好同主流幣方向有氣氛參考。

stories.title: ZeruAI 經委託熱錢包讀冷錢包歷史（Zaps／Delegate.xyz）
stories.title_en: ZeruAI Enables Cold Wallet History Access via Delegated Hot Wallets on Zaps
stories.summary: ZeruAI 喺 Zaps 接入 Delegate.xyz，用戶可用熱錢包委託讀冷錢包活動分數／歷史，強調唔直接碰資產。
stories.summary_en: ZeruAI launched delegated wallet connections on its Zaps platform, integrating with Delegate.xyz so users can link a hot wallet to score activity from their offline cold wallet. This solves a key DeFi pain point, rewarding genuine trading and engagement while keeping cold storage secure—users just need to review permissions first. The update fits ZeruAI's shift to Activity Fi, where zScore has already analyzed over 320 million wallets to base rewards on verifiable behavior, not just launch timing. It improves ecosystem attribution as early activity markets like zETH gear up.
stories.why_it_matters: 冷／熱錢包委託工具流行，提醒權限同釣魚風險；安全敘事影響週末防範意識。

stories.title: BAYC 玩家用官方 swap 追 Curtis 稀有特徵
stories.title_en: Bored Ape Collectors Swap for Rare Curtis Traits on BAYC Platform
stories.summary: Bored Ape Yacht Club fans are using bayc.com/trade, a peer-to-peer NFT swap tool, to trade directly for apes featuring hot 'Curtis' traits…
stories.summary_en: Bored Ape Yacht Club fans are using bayc.com/trade, a peer-to-peer NFT swap tool, to trade directly for apes featuring hot 'Curtis' traits like captain's hats. Assets stay safely in wallets while users propose offchain orders that anyone can execute onchain with secure contracts. Recent action includes Ape #4854 selling for 7.1 ETH and a trader offering multiple rare items for matching Curtis apes, helping collectors build sets without scams or middlemen. The platform supports BAYC and other collections, keeping the club lively as fans rotate holdings for perfect traits.
stories.why_it_matters: 藍籌 NFT 換貨活躍，風險資產情緒嘅邊角指標。

stories.title: Binance 熱錢包被盜後團隊通宵凍結約一半資金
stories.title_en: Binance Hit by Record $6.3 Billion Crypto Heist from Suspected North Korean Hackers
stories.summary: Blockchain firms like TRM Labs, Chainalysis, and Elliptic pinned the October 29 attack on North Korea's TraderTraitor group, citing tactics…
stories.summary_en: Blockchain firms like TRM Labs, Chainalysis, and Elliptic pinned the October 29 attack on North Korea's TraderTraitor group, citing tactics matching the 2025 Bybit hack. A compromised DevOps engineer's laptop allowed unauthorized withdrawals, but Binance found no private key leaks and quickly froze $3 billion with partners—using savvy DeFi moves to dodge some stablecoin freezes. The exchange committed its $1.x billion SAFU fund, over $1 billion in SpaceX shares, and treasury reserves to cover all user losses fully, unlike the devastating Mt. Gox collapse. Bitcoin prices held steady as leaders like Michael Saylor praised Binance's resolve.
stories.why_it_matters: 與 $63 億案同一敘事線，關注凍結同復牌節奏。

stories.title: Satoshi 約 $850 億 BTC 囤幣在駭客潮下仍未動用
stories.title_en: Satoshi's $85 Billion Bitcoin Hoard Stays Untouched Amid Crypto Hacks
stories.summary: Arkham 追蹤 Satoshi 持倉分散逾 21,900 地址、各有獨立私鑰； amidst 大型駭客事件，相關地址仍無移動。
stories.summary_en: Arkham Intelligence tracks Satoshi's holdings across over 21,900 separate addresses, each locked by its own unique 256-bit private key—making brute-force attacks impossible, as they'd require testing more possibilities than exist in the universe's age. The Binance $6.3 billion hack on October 29-30, 2026, linked to North Korean hackers, fueled questions, but experts note the coins' design from Bitcoin's earliest days, predating modern seed phrases, keeps them safe. Even quantum threats remain distant, and stealing such a hoard would likely crash its own value through market panic.
stories.why_it_matters: Satoshi 幣未動緩解「巨鯨拋壓」焦慮；同 Binance 被盜新聞對照，影響 BTC 週末定價敘事。

stories.title: Zeru Finance 推出 zETH Activity Market，獎勵真實鏈上活躍
stories.title_en: Zeru Finance Launches zETH Activity Market Rewarding Real Ethereum Users
stories.summary: Zeru Finance kicks off its first Activity Market with zETH today, October 31, letting verified users with proven onchain history—like…
stories.summary_en: Zeru Finance kicks off its first Activity Market with zETH today, October 31, letting verified users with proven onchain history—like trading, staking, and governance—compete for spots to launch meme coins. Users mint zScore NFTs at zaps.markets, link up to 10 wallets, and climb a public leaderboard during a 15-day race starting at 13:00 UTC, while the community votes on token name and artwork. This model skips dev allocations and sniper dominance by filtering out wash trading and Sybils, directing fees to buybacks with locked liquidity, aiming to fairly reward real contributors amid past launch flaws like clustered wallets grabbing most supply.
stories.why_it_matters: 公平發射敘事對抗 sniper；meme 發射機制變化值得跟。

stories.title: 週末加密圈「Touch Grass」提醒刷屏
stories.title_en: Weekend 'Touch Grass' Reminders Fill Crypto Feeds
stories.summary: Crypto and Web3 users are sharing lighthearted posts this Saturday, urging each other to log off and enjoy the outdoors. Examples include…
stories.summary_en: Crypto and Web3 users are sharing lighthearted posts this Saturday, urging each other to log off and enjoy the outdoors. Examples include SDK asking 'are you touching grass today?' and JC wondering if it's time to touch grass or keep grinding. The slang, meaning to reconnect with real-world activities away from devices, dates back to 2015 and reflects a push for balance in busy online communities, often paired with fun memes.
stories.why_it_matters: 週末情緒偏休息，急升機會可能較靜。

stories.title: Trezor 警告 CryptoBilis 渠道硬體錢包疑被植入蜂窩模組
stories.title_en: Trezor Warns of Tampered Hardware Wallets from CryptoBilis
stories.summary: Trezor 籲自 2026-03 起經前經銷商 CryptoBilis 購買任何型號嘅用戶，立即將資金轉至新錢包並用新助記詞。
stories.summary_en: Trezor urges customers who bought any model from former reseller CryptoBilis since March 2026 to immediately move funds to new wallets with fresh recovery seeds. The alert stems from a credible report of one tampered Safe 5 purchased in August via Tokopedia, featuring an extra circuit board between the main board and screen that reads and sends wallet info when plugged in. No fund losses reported yet, but Trezor offers free replacements and advises against using or restoring seeds on suspect devices, following earlier tampered Ledger finds from the same seller.
stories.why_it_matters: 硬體錢包供應鏈風險；自我託管用戶要改用官方渠道。

stories.title: Pump.fun Callout 獎勵引熱議，有人單日收 $3.2 萬
stories.title_en: Pump.fun Traders Share Big Callout Rewards Amid Skepticism
stories.summary: Pump.fun callout 計劃讓用戶向粉絲廣播代幣提示並按「Activity」賺 USDC；社群有人晒賞亦有人質疑透明度。
stories.summary_en: Pump.fun's callout rewards program lets users broadcast token tips to followers, earning daily USDC payouts based on a confidential 'Activity Metric' that now prioritizes follower profits over mere volume. While screenshots show impressive hauls like $32,000 in a day and millions paid out since August, complaints highlight tiny rewards for 239x calls and questions about funding sustainability. The platform is doubling down with a new Creator Program and $100,000 competition starting November 2 to boost social features in the memecoin world.
stories.why_it_matters: 社交喊單激勵改權重，影響 Sol meme 流量同跟單噪音。

stories.title: 以太坊驗證者湧入 mump2p，區塊傳播顯著加快
stories.title_en: Ethereum Validators Boost Network Speed with mump2p Adoption Surge
stories.summary: Optimum's mump2p protocol uses Random Linear Network Coding to spread block data faster across Ethereum without changing core rules. In the…
stories.summary_en: Optimum's mump2p protocol uses Random Linear Network Coding to spread block data faster across Ethereum without changing core rules. In the past week, Total Value Boosted jumped 76 percent to 2.49 million ETH, with blocks arriving 277 milliseconds earlier on average and propagation tightening by a factor of 3.2. A Blockdaemon case study showed 39.7 percent fewer wrong head votes and 92 percent of blocks first seen via mump2p. Kept free for validators, it builds a reliable mesh that benefits everyone from node operators to traders needing quick data.
stories.why_it_matters: ETH 基建加速有利短線交易體驗同網路健康。

stories.title: SEC 就加密相關規則公開徵意見（截止 12/14）
stories.title_en: CFTC Proposes Crypto Exchange Registration After $6.3 Billion Binance Hack
stories.summary: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission is offering crypto exchanges a voluntary federal registration option, applying the same…
stories.summary_en: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission is offering crypto exchanges a voluntary federal registration option, applying the same cybersecurity standards, customer fund protections, and oversight as traditional derivatives markets. Chairman Selig highlighted the Binance breach in a CNBC interview as validation for the proposal issued earlier this month, noting blockchain's potential to trace stolen funds. The move targets platforms offering leveraged retail trading and has drawn praise from observers for boosting confidence, though it remains optional without congressional action for broader mandates. Public comments are due by December 14.
stories.why_it_matters: 監管徵意見窗口開啟，中長期合規敘事參考。

stories.title: Hoodminers Lightpaper 談更安全上幣流程
stories.title_en: Hoodminers Lightpaper Sparks Talk on Safer Token Listings
stories.summary: Hoodminers, on Robinhood Chain with NFT rigs for earning and launching tokens, outlines a deliberate listing process in its…
stories.summary_en: Hoodminers, on Robinhood Chain with NFT rigs for earning and launching tokens, outlines a deliberate listing process in its lightpaper—pools get vetted before routing user money. Users emphasize that token pages should display key details like fees, pool setups, and contracts upfront to help evaluate risks, rather than just hyping trades. While checks signal care for user capital, they don't predict success, fueling calls for platforms that balance discovery with clear warnings on opportunities and limits.
stories.why_it_matters: Robinhood Chain 發射敘事；對 meme 上幣風險教育有關。

stories.title: SPX6900 靠社區死撐，市值約 $3.4 億
stories.title_en: SPX6900 Memecoin Thrives on Relentless Community Positivity
stories.summary: SPX6900 2023-08 於以太坊作為諷刺 Meme 上線，無團隊路線圖、靠社群敘事；近期討論再起。
stories.summary_en: SPX6900 launched on Ethereum in August 2023 as a satirical memecoin aiming to outgrow the S&P 500, with no team or roadmap—just community conviction. Holders rally around slogans like 'stop trading and believe in something,' sharing daily dollar-cost averaging posts, such as one marking day 495 of $1,000 buys, and colorful art featuring jester motifs. Recent trading shows big spot buys over $900,000 alongside steady small purchases, as the token's price sits around $0.36 and the group grows through memes and a circulating collage of hundreds of profile pictures.
stories.why_it_matters: 強社區 meme 仍吸引資金，對急升板情緒有參考。

stories.title: Walmart 系 OnePay 支援 USDC 直入支票戶口
stories.title_en: OnePay Enables Direct USDC Deposits to Checking Accounts
stories.summary: Walmart-backed OnePay launched a feature for select U.S. customers to deposit USDC directly into their checking balances, converting…
stories.summary_en: Walmart-backed OnePay launched a feature for select U.S. customers to deposit USDC directly into their checking balances, converting stablecoins to dollars in moments via Stripe’s Bridge platform. It supports 12 blockchains like Solana and Ethereum, making it easier for freelancers and gig workers to use crypto earnings for bills and transfers. Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire praised the step toward integrating USDC into everyday retail finance apps, amid stablecoin volumes reaching $1.79 trillion in June 2026.
stories.why_it_matters: 穩定幣日常支付落地，利好合規穩定幣敘事。

stories.title: 交易員 Frank 平倉約 $1230 萬 meme 空單獲利離場
stories.title_en: Crypto Trader Frank Closes Million-Dollar Memecoin Shorts
stories.summary: Frank 關閉約 $1230 萬槓桿空單（BTC、ZEC、NEAR、PUMP 等）並鎖定利潤，社群討論短線擁擠交易。
stories.summary_en: Frank, a seasoned crypto trader, shuttered his $12.3 million leveraged short positions on Bitcoin, ZEC, NEAR, and PUMP after booking profits amid a memecoin cooldown. He reflected on the mental strain, noting how holding through drawdowns often earns the 'cancer holder' label, while still believing in the sector's long-term potential but advising against hero plays. The memecoin market has dropped to $30 billion from $150 billion peaks in late 2024, with most tokens crashing 90% or more from highs and rarely recovering, though traders keep hunting for the next big winner amid emotional whiplash.
stories.why_it_matters: meme 市值從高峰大幅回落，空頭獲利了結暗示短線波動未完。

stories.title: XRP 回調至約 $1.24，技術派睇 Wave 3 上攻
stories.title_en: XRP Dips to $1.24 as Traders Eye Wave 3 Rally to $4
stories.summary: Traders note XRP hit $1.1989 before rebounding from the expected $1.2133 support, completing Wave 2 in an Elliott Wave pattern and…
stories.summary_en: Traders note XRP hit $1.1989 before rebounding from the expected $1.2133 support, completing Wave 2 in an Elliott Wave pattern and targeting Wave 3 at $4.11. At Ripple's Swell conference, CEO Brad Garlinghouse reaffirmed XRP's top priority, stressing the company only pursues moves good for the token and views its stablecoin as complementary. Community figures like CTO Emeritus David Schwartz urged hopping on the XRP train, while some holders swap other cryptos into XRP ahead of potential advances toward $6.80 on longer charts.
stories.why_it_matters: 山寨技術反彈敘事，模擬倉分散度參考。

stories.title: 交易員 TOGI 全倉押注 MSTR 下跌期權
stories.title_en: Trader Bets Entire Portfolio on MicroStrategy Drop After Binance Hack
stories.summary: On October 30, 2026, Stoffer announced the all-in move on MSTR puts with $100 and $90 strikes, as shares fell 9% to near $128 amid broader…
stories.summary_en: On October 30, 2026, Stoffer announced the all-in move on MSTR puts with $100 and $90 strikes, as shares fell 9% to near $128 amid broader market weakness. The bet followed a record $6.3 billion Binance hack by suspected North Korean actors, prompting users to note the timing's irony and call it scarier than the breach itself. MicroStrategy, holding over 848,000 BTC, had just reported strong Q3 results and plans to raise up to $30 billion in Bitcoin-backed credit for more acquisitions. Stoffer plans a potential exit Monday and stressed it's not financial advice.
stories.why_it_matters: 高調空頭倉加重週末波動預期。

stories.title: MSTR 跌約 9%，交易員大舉買入看跌期權
stories.title_en: Traders Bet Big on MicroStrategy Puts as Stock Drops 9%
stories.summary: MicroStrategy stock fell about 9% to around $129 on Thursday, pressured by broader crypto market woes including a major exchange hack.…
stories.summary_en: MicroStrategy stock fell about 9% to around $129 on Thursday, pressured by broader crypto market woes including a major exchange hack. Traders rushed into put options like December and January 2027 contracts, with premiums spiking as activity heated up in trading apps. This came right after the company's Q3 earnings call, where executives detailed a new capital strategy featuring preferred-stock issuance and a large cash reserve to grow their 848,000 BTC holdings more efficiently. While some traders scored on puts, others cautioned that big drops can wipe out premium-selling gains in volatile names like MSTR.
stories.why_it_matters: BTC 代理股波動放大，短線風險偏好指標。

stories.title: Polymarket 因第三方腳本被駭暫停交易（約 $270 萬）
stories.title_en: Polymarket Halts Trading After Third-Party Hack Drains $2.7 Million
stories.summary: 攻擊者利用英國 DebugBear 真實用戶監測腳本注入惡意碼，竊取登入 session 賣出持倉；平台暫停交易調查。
stories.summary_en: Attackers exploited a real-user monitoring script from UK firm DebugBear, injecting malicious code that accessed logged-in sessions to sell positions and withdraw about $2.7 million to a single wallet. Polymarket quickly fixed the issue, refunded nearly all 726 affected users without a claims process, and added $1.19 million for trading losses, totaling $3.9 million in compensation. The incident highlighted risks of third-party JavaScript on financial sites, with some larger claimants facing strict KYC and non-disparagement terms before payouts.
stories.why_it_matters: 預測市場第三方供應鏈攻擊再次提醒依賴外掛腳本風險；影響週末 DeFi／投機情緒。

Data from Lumos shows control hijacking via social engineering caused $3.31 billion in losses—over three times more than smart contract bugs at $983 million. stories.summary_en: On October 29, attackers stole funds from Binance and funneled $60 million in USDT to Aave V3 Ethereum, borrowing $44.6 million in WETH before Aave froze 292 reserves across 16 networks as a precaution. Markets reopened in stages, with CEO Stani Kulechov confirming normal operations while certain assets like USDT face temporary limits to curb volatility. The event sparked DeFi talks on risk tools like freezes versus isolated markets in protocols such as Morpho Blue.

stories.summary_en: Murad, a prominent memecoin advocate, argued that community-driven memecoins will outperform utility and revenue-focused projects once artificial general intelligence automates code-based models. stories.summary_en: Since September 10, at least two victims fell prey to tampered Ledger cryptocurrency hardware wallets sold at some Singapore retail outlets, with malicious components stealing recovery phrases and private keys for unauthorized transfers.
